description: This file defines an Android Fragment named AppUsageStatisticsFragment that demonstrates how to use the Android App Usage Statistics API. It manages UI components like RecyclerView and Spinner, retrieves usage stats data, and updates a list display with app usage information.

classes.name: AppUsageStatisticsFragment
classes.description: Android Fragment that displays app usage statistics, allowing users to select time intervals and view app usage details.

classes.name: LastTimeLaunchedComparatorDesc
classes.description: Comparator class for sorting UsageStats objects by last used time in descending order.

classes.name: StatsUsageInterval
classes.description: Enum representing different time intervals (Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Yearly) for usage data.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up UI components and event listeners.

methods.name: getUsageStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves app usage data for a specified interval and prompts the user to grant permission if necessary.

methods.name: updateAppsList
methods.description: Updates the RecyclerView with usage data, including app icons.
